meta.description: Why do company WhatsApp numbers get banned? Learn the causes of account restrictions, how the WhatsApp Business API differs, and steps that lower ban risk.

hero.question: Is your company's number getting banned when you message customers?

intro.text: If your company relies on WhatsApp to talk to customers or run marketing campaigns, you may face a restricted or banned number, especially when you use unsuitable sending methods or message heavily without following WhatsApp's policies.
intro.highlight: The solution isn't to stop using WhatsApp, but to use it the right way.
intro.platform: With HRwhats, you can move from regular WhatsApp use to a professional environment built on the WhatsApp Business Platform (API), and manage your company's communication and campaigns in a more organized way.

reasons.title: Why might a WhatsApp number get banned?
reasons.lead: The risk of account restrictions can rise with practices such as:
items: Sending large numbers of messages through unofficial methods.
Using unapproved sending software or tools.
Messaging people who didn't expect to hear from your business.
High rates of people blocking or reporting your messages.
Not giving customers a clear way to stop the messages.

honest.question: Does the WhatsApp API prevent bans completely?
honest.statement: No method can guarantee 100% that an account won't be restricted.
honest.text: Using the WhatsApp Business Platform the right way helps companies manage communication and campaigns through official channels, but you must also follow WhatsApp's policies, consent requirements, and message quality standards.

banned.question: Has your company's WhatsApp number already been banned?
paragraphs: If the number is restricted or banned, first find out the reason for the restriction and follow the review procedures that WhatsApp/Meta offer, where they apply.
Trying to get around the ban with tools or new numbers, to continue the same practices that caused the problem, is not recommended.
Once the cause is fixed, you can build a more organized way of communicating that reduces the chance of the problem happening again.
